JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = re.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
    WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)

    FROM capital_snapshot cs2
    WHERE cs2.institution_id = eg.institution_id

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN organization_profile op ON op.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = op.industry_code
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE rc.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)

    WHERE rc2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)

SELECT
    ds.loan_id,
    ds.principal_overdue_days,
    cg.grade_name_zh,
    rc.as_of_date
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ds.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON cg.grade_code = rc.grade_code
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 90
  AND cg.grade_name_zh IN ('正常', '关注')
  AND rc.as_of_date = (
      SELECT MAX(rc2.as_of_date)
      FROM risk_classification rc2
      WHERE rc2.loan_id = ds.loan_id
  )
ORDER BY ds.principal_overdue_days DESC, ds.loan_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS insufficient_provision_loan_balance
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
    WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
AND ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(lbs.principal_balance) > 100000000
ORDER BY insufficient_provision_loan_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

    pi.loan_id,
    p.display_name AS payee_name,
    isec.sector_name_zh,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi

SELECT

    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS restricted_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN ind.risk_category IN ('RESTRICTED', 'EXIT') THEN pi.instruction_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(pi.instruction_amount), 4) AS ratio
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector ind ON ind.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(pi.instruction_amount) > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pt.name_zh AS payment_type_name,
    pe.amount,
    ou.unit_name AS org_unit_name
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN payment_type_catalog pt ON pt.payment_type = pe.payment_type
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = pe.origin_org_unit_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
  AND pe.amount > 5000000
  AND pe.status = 'CLEARED'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    borrower_industry.sector_name_zh AS borrower_industry_name,
    target_industry.sector_name_zh AS target_industry_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party borrower ON ca.borrower_party_id = borrower.party_id
JOIN organization_profile borrower_org ON borrower_org.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN industry_sector borrower_industry ON borrower_org.industry_code = borrower_industry.sector_code
LEFT JOIN industry_sector target_industry ON ca.target_industry_code = target_industry.sector_code
WHERE borrower_org.industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND ca.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
  AND borrower_org.industry_code != ca.target_industry_code
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT
    pe.payment_id,
    pe.business_date,
    pe.amount,
    p_from.party_id AS payer_party_id,
    p_to.party_id AS payee_party_id
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON pe.from_account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN account acc_to ON pe.to_account_id = acc_to.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_from ON acc_from.account_id = ah_from.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah_to ON acc_to.account_id = ah_to.account_id
JOIN party p_from ON ah_from.party_id = p_from.party_id
JOIN party p_to ON ah_to.party_id = p_to.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = p_from.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = p_to.party_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
ORDER BY pe.amount DESC, pe.payment_id;

    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 3
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, ca.agreement_id;

GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name

JOIN service_operator so ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id

    institution_name,
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    balance_rank
FROM RankedLoans
WHERE balance_rank = 1
ORDER BY institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        ca.target_industry_code
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.target_industry_code,
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.principal_balance,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lb.target_industry_code ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) AS rnk
    FROM loan_balance lb
    WHERE lb.target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    isc.sector_name_zh,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.principal_balance,
    rl.rnk
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN industry_sector isc ON rl.target_industry_code = isc.sector_code
WHERE rl.rnk <= 3
ORDER BY isc.sector_name_zh ASC, rl.rnk ASC;

WITH daily_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        business_date,
        COUNT(*) AS daily_count
    FROM payment_event
    GROUP BY business_date
)
SELECT 
    business_date,
    daily_count,
    daily_count - LAG(daily_count) OVER (ORDER BY business_date) AS count_change
FROM daily_counts
ORDER BY business_date;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    lbs.loan_id,
    lbs.principal_balance,
    avg_inst.avg_principal_balance,
    lbs.principal_balance - avg_inst.avg_principal_balance AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON ca.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca2.institution_id,
        AVG(lbs2.principal_balance) AS avg_principal_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON lbs2.loan_id = ld2.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ld2.agreement_id = ca2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) avg_inst ON ca.institution_id = avg_inst.institution_id
WHERE lbs.principal_balance > avg_inst.avg_principal_balance
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, lbs.loan_id;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    COUNT(gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE sa.security_type = '第三方保证'
  AND sa.security_id NOT IN (
      SELECT cl.security_id
      FROM collateral_link cl
      WHERE cl.status = '有效' -- 假设只有有效的关联才算有关联，或者根据业务逻辑可能需要去掉status过滤，这里假设所有记录都有效或需明确状态。根据schema，collateral_link有status字段。通常“没有任何抵押物关联”指不存在记录。
  )
GROUP BY sa.security_id, sa.secured_amount
ORDER BY sa.secured_amount DESC;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days = 0 THEN '0'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN '1-30'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 31 AND 90 THEN '31-90'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 91 AND 180 THEN '91-180'
        WHEN ds.principal_overdue_days BETWEEN 181 AND 360 THEN '181-360'
        ELSE '360+'
    END AS overdue_interval,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM delinquency_snapshot ds
GROUP BY overdue_interval
ORDER BY overdue_interval ASC;

SELECT
    cv.collateral_id,
    cv.valued_on,
    COUNT(*) AS record_count
FROM
    collateral_valuation cv
GROUP BY
    cv.collateral_id,
    cv.valued_on
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    cv.collateral_id ASC;

WITH loan_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(*) AS loan_count,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance,
        AVG(ld.disbursed_amount) AS avg_loan_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    -- 获取最新的余额快照，假设 as_of_date 最大的为最新
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date) 
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    ls.borrower_party_id,
    ls.loan_count,
    ls.total_principal_balance,
    ls.avg_loan_amount
FROM loan_stats ls
ORDER BY ls.avg_loan_amount DESC
LIMIT 5;

SELECT
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count,
    COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS cash_transaction_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN service_operator so ON so.staff_id = sm.staff_id
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.operator_id = so.operator_id
WHERE pe.is_cash = 1
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY cash_transaction_count DESC, ou.org_unit_id
LIMIT 10;

SELECT
    p.customer_segment AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(pp.party_id) AS customer_count,
    ROUND(AVG(pp.annual_income), 2) AS avg_annual_income,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN pp.annual_income > 1000000 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(pp.party_id), 4) AS high_income_ratio
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY p.customer_segment
ORDER BY p.customer_segment ASC;

WITH payment_data AS (
    SELECT 
        pe.payment_id,
        pe.amount,
        pe.currency_code,
        pe.business_date,
        pe.event_time,
        pe.status,
        pe.exception_flag,
        pe.from_account_id,
        pe.to_account_id,
        pe.operator_id,
        pe.origin_org_unit_id,
        pe.balance_after,
        pe.memo,
        pe.channel,
        pe.payment_type,
        pe.is_cash,
        -- 确定付款账户所属机构
        CASE 
            WHEN fa.institution_id IS NOT NULL THEN fa.institution_id
            WHEN ta.institution_id IS NOT NULL THEN ta.institution_id
            ELSE NULL
        END AS reporting_institution_id,
        -- 确定付款账户主持有人
        fa_h.party_id AS from_party_id,
        -- 确定收款账户主持有人
        ta_h.party_id AS to_party_id
    FROM payment_event pe
    LEFT JOIN account fa ON pe.from_account_id = fa.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account ta ON pe.to_account_id = ta.account_id
    LEFT JOIN account_holder fa_h ON fa.account_id = fa_h.account_id 
        AND fa_h.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' 
        AND pe.business_date >= fa_h.effective_from 
        AND (fa_h.effective_to IS NULL OR pe.business_date <= fa_h.effective_to)
    LEFT JOIN account_holder ta_h ON ta.account_id = ta_h.account_id 
        AND ta_h.holder_role = 'PRIMARY' 
        AND pe.business_date >= ta_h.effective_from 
        AND (ta_h.effective_to IS NULL OR pe.business_date <= ta_h.effective_to)
),
related_check AS (
    SELECT 
        pd.*,
        CASE 
            WHEN pr.relation_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 
            ELSE 0 
        END AS is_related
    FROM payment_data pd
    LEFT JOIN party_relation pr 
        ON pr.source_party_id = pd.from_party_id 
        AND pr.target_party_id = pd.to_party_id
        AND pd.business_date >= pr.effective_from 
        AND (pr.effective_to IS NULL OR pd.business_date <= pr.effective_to)
        AND pr.relation_type != 'NON-RELATED' -- 排除非关联方
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rc.is_related = 1 THEN rc.amount ELSE 0 END), 2) AS related_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(rc.amount), 2) AS total_amount,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN rc.is_related = 1 THEN rc.amount ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / SUM(rc.amount), 2) AS related_ratio
FROM related_check rc
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = rc.reporting_institution_id
WHERE rc.reporting_institution_id IS NOT NULL
  AND rc.amount > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY related_ratio DESC;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS credit_card_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT td.account_id) AS term_deposit_account_count
FROM party p
JOIN person_profile pp ON pp.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.holder_party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account acc_card ON acc_card.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id
JOIN account acc_td ON acc_td.account_id = td.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = acc_td.account_id
WHERE pc.card_type = 'CREDIT_CARD'
  AND acc_card.account_kind = 'DEBIT' -- 贷记卡通常关联借记卡作为结算账户，或者根据具体业务定义，这里假设结算账户存在
  AND acc_td.account_kind = 'TERM_DEPOSIT'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING credit_card_count > 0 AND term_deposit_account_count > 0
ORDER BY term_deposit_account_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    AVG(julianday('2026-06-30') - julianday(ld.disbursed_on)) AS avg_loan_age_days
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY avg_loan_age_days DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lds.loan_id,
        lds.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY lds.principal_balance DESC) AS quartile_group
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
    WHERE lds.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    quartile_group
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY quartile_group ASC, principal_balance DESC, loan_id ASC
LIMIT 40;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ip.project_industry_code AS industry_code,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    JOIN private_credit_profile ip ON ld.loan_id = ip.asset_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY ip.project_industry_code
),
total_balance AS (
    SELECT SUM(principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_balance
),
ranked_industries AS (
    SELECT 
        lb.industry_code,
        lb.principal_balance,
        SUM(lb.principal_balance) OVER (ORDER BY lb.principal_balance DESC) AS cumulative_balance
    FROM loan_balance lb
    CROSS JOIN total_balance tb
),
cumulative_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        ri.industry_code,
        ri.principal_balance,
        ri.cumulative_balance,
        ri.cumulative_balance * 1.0 / tb.total_principal AS cumulative_ratio
    FROM ranked_industries ri
    CROSS JOIN total_balance tb
)
SELECT 
    isc.sector_name_zh AS industry_name,
    ROUND(cr.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
    ROUND(cr.cumulative_ratio, 4) AS cumulative_ratio
FROM cumulative_ratio cr
JOIN industry_sector isc ON cr.industry_code = isc.sector_code
WHERE cr.cumulative_ratio <= 0.8
ORDER BY cr.cumulative_ratio ASC, cr.industry_code;

SELECT
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS unsettled_loan_count
FROM party p
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
)
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.status != 'CLOSED'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(ld.loan_id) >= 2
ORDER BY unsettled_loan_count DESC, p.party_id, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    sa.secured_amount,
    ca.collateral_id,
    cv.valuation_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cl.collateral_id
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = (
    SELECT MAX(cv2.valued_on)
    FROM collateral_valuation cv2
    WHERE cv2.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
)
AND cv.valuation_amount > sa.secured_amount * 2.0
ORDER BY (cv.valuation_amount - sa.secured_amount) DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT
    p.party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ah.account_id) AS account_count
FROM account_holder ah
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ah.party_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'PERSON'
GROUP BY p.party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.institution_id) > 2
ORDER BY account_count DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    pe.from_account_id AS account_id,
    pe.business_date,
    COUNT(*) AS transaction_count
FROM
    payment_event pe
WHERE
    pe.from_account_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY
    pe.from_account_id,
    pe.business_date
HAVING
    COUNT(*) >= 3
ORDER BY
    transaction_count DESC,
    pe.from_account_id,
    pe.business_date
LIMIT 20;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_principal_balance
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = p.home_org_unit_id
LEFT JOIN risk_exposure re ON re.obligor_party_id = egm.party_id
LEFT JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = re.agreement_id
LEFT JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE p.party_type = 'ORGANIZATION'
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal_balance DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    gc.guarantor_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    COUNT(*) AS security_count,
    ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id, p.display_name
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1 AND SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) > 300000000
ORDER BY total_guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ld.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND ld.closed_on IS NULL
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(ls.loan_id) AS loan_count
FROM loan_balance_snapshot ls
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
WHERE ls.as_of_date = '2026-06-30'
  AND ls.overdue_since IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday(ls.as_of_date) - julianday(ls.overdue_since)) >= 90
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    pi.instruction_amount,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN payment_instruction pi ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.payment_mode = '受托支付'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN party_status ps ON ps.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ps.status = '冻结'
  AND ca.status = '生效'
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    lpc.product_name_zh,
    isec.sector_name_zh AS target_industry,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN loan_product_catalog lpc ON lpc.product_code = ca.product_family
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE lpc.is_working_capital = 1
  AND isec.risk_category = 'EXIT'
  AND ld.status = 'NORMAL'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    lds.loan_id,
    lds.principal_balance,
    avg_inst.avg_balance,
    lds.principal_balance - avg_inst.avg_balance AS excess_amount
FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = lds.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ca2.institution_id,
        AVG(lds2.principal_balance) AS avg_balance
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lds2
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.loan_id = lds2.loan_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca2 ON ca2.agreement_id = ld2.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca2.institution_id
) avg_inst ON avg_inst.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE lds.principal_balance > avg_inst.avg_balance * 2.0
ORDER BY excess_amount DESC, lds.loan_id;

WITH institution_total AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
non_related_amount AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS non_related_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id NOT IN (
        SELECT pr.source_party_id
        FROM party_relation pr
        WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
    )
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) AS non_related_amount,
    it.total_amount,
    ROUND(COALESCE(nra.non_related_amount, 0) * 1.0 / it.total_amount, 4) AS ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN institution_total it ON it.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN non_related_amount nra ON nra.institution_id = i.institution_id
ORDER BY ratio DESC;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        ld.institution_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ld.institution_id, ca.borrower_party_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    WHERE as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
),
concentration AS (
    SELECT 
        inst.institution_name,
        p.display_name AS customer_name,
        lt.total_principal_balance,
        ic.net_capital,
        ROUND(lt.total_principal_balance * 1.0 / ic.net_capital * 100, 2) AS concentration_pct
    FROM loan_totals lt
    JOIN institution inst ON inst.institution_id = lt.institution_id
    JOIN party p ON p.party_id = lt.borrower_party_id
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON ic.institution_id = lt.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
)
SELECT 
    institution_name,
    customer_name,
    total_principal_balance,
    net_capital,
    concentration_pct
FROM concentration
WHERE concentration_pct > 10
ORDER BY concentration_pct DESC, institution_name, customer_name
LIMIT 200;

WITH industry_avg AS (
    SELECT 
        target_industry_code,
        AVG(annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement
    WHERE annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND target_industry_code IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY target_industry_code
)
SELECT 
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ca.annual_interest_rate,
    ia.avg_rate AS industry_avg_rate,
    ROUND((ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate, 2) AS spread_pct
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN industry_avg ia ON ia.target_industry_code = ca.target_industry_code
WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate IS NOT NULL
  AND ia.avg_rate > 0
  AND (ca.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate) * 100.0 / ia.avg_rate > 10
ORDER BY spread_pct DESC, ca.agreement_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT re.obligor_party_id) AS 超限客户数
FROM risk_exposure re
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = re.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = re.institution_id
                       AND cs.as_of_date = re.as_of_date
WHERE re.exposure_type = 'LOAN'
  AND cs.net_capital > 0
  AND re.gross_exposure * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY 超限客户数 DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH group_exposure AS (
    -- 1. 找出所有集团客户 (exposure_group)
    -- 2. 找出该集团下的所有成员 (exposure_group_member)
    -- 3. 找出这些成员作为借款人的授信合同 (credit_agreement)
    -- 4. 找出这些合同项下的借据 (loan_drawdown)
    -- 5. 获取借据的本金余额 (loan_balance_snapshot)
    -- 6. 获取主办机构 (institution_id from exposure_group) 的资本净额 (capital_snapshot)
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id AS host_institution_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        cs.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    -- 确保取最新的资本净额快照，假设 as_of_date 最大的为最新，或者根据业务逻辑取特定日期。
    -- 题目未指定具体日期，通常取最新或指定报告期。这里假设取最新的一条记录，或者如果有多条，可能需要聚合。
    -- 为了简化，假设每个机构在每个时间点只有一条记录，或者我们取最新的。
    -- 由于 capital_snapshot 有 as_of_date，我们需要确定一个基准日期。
    -- 题目说“资本净额取集团主办机构的资本净额”，未指定日期。
    -- 通常这类集中度分析是基于某个报告日。
    -- 让我们假设我们使用 loan_balance_snapshot 中的最新 as_of_date 作为基准，或者取所有快照的平均/最新。
    -- 更严谨的做法是：对于每个 exposure_group，找到其 host_institution 的最新 net_capital。
    -- 同时，loan_balance_snapshot 也有 as_of_date。
    -- 为了匹配，我们可能需要在一个共同的 as_of_date 上计算。
    -- 但题目没有给出共同的日期。
    -- 让我们重新审视： "仅统计该主办机构自身签署的授信合同项下借据"。
    -- 这意味着我们只关心 host_institution_id 签署的合同。
    -- 关于日期：通常监管指标是时点指标。
    -- 让我们假设我们取 loan_balance_snapshot 中的最新日期作为分析基准，并取该日期或最新日期的资本净额。
    -- 或者，更简单的解释：计算当前的集中度。
    -- 让我们取 loan_balance_snapshot 中每个 loan_id 的最新余额，以及对应 host_institution 的最新资本净额。
    
    -- 为了处理日期匹配，我们先获取每个 loan_id 的最新余额
    , latest_loan_balance AS (
        SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, as_of_date
        FROM (
            SELECT loan_id, principal_balance, as_of_date,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY loan_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) as rn
            FROM loan_balance_snapshot
        )
        WHERE rn = 1
    )
    -- 获取 host_institution 的最新资本净额
    , latest_capital AS (
        SELECT institution_id, net_capital, as_of_date
        FROM (
            SELECT institution_id, net_capital, as_of_date,
                   ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY institution_id ORDER BY as_of_date DESC) as rn
            FROM capital_snapshot
        )
        WHERE rn = 1
    )
    SELECT 
        eg.exposure_group_id,
        eg.group_name,
        eg.institution_id AS host_institution_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ltb.principal_balance,
        lc.net_capital
    FROM exposure_group eg
    JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id AND ca.institution_id = eg.institution_id
    JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    JOIN latest_loan_balance ltb ON ltb.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = eg.institution_id
),
group_totals AS (
    -- 计算每个集团的总敞口余额
    SELECT 
        exposure_group_id,
        group_name,
        host_institution_id,
        SUM(principal_balance) AS total_exposure,
        net_capital
    FROM group_exposure
    GROUP BY exposure_group_id, group_name, host_institution_id, net_capital
)
SELECT 
    gt.exposure_group_id,
    gt.group_name,
    gt.total_exposure,
    gt.net_capital,
    ROUND(gt.total_exposure * 1.0 / gt.net_capital, 6) AS concentration_ratio
FROM group_totals gt
WHERE gt.net_capital > 0
  AND gt.total_exposure * 1.0 / gt.net_capital > 0.10
ORDER BY concentration_ratio DESC, gt.exposure_group_id;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.maturity_on,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.status,
    ca.contract_amount
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'EXPIRED'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id AS disbursement_account_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    pe.payment_id AS transfer_payment_id,
    pe.business_date AS transfer_date,
    pe.amount AS transfer_amount,
    CAST(julianday(pe.business_date) - julianday(ld.disbursed_on) AS INTEGER) AS days_interval
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN payment_event pe ON pe.from_account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE pe.business_date > ld.disbursed_on
  AND pe.business_date <= date(ld.disbursed_on, '+7 days')
  AND pe.status = 'SETTLED'
ORDER BY days_interval ASC, pe.amount DESC, ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_balance AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        ld.obligor_party_id,
        ld.institution_id,
        MAX(lbs.principal_balance) AS max_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON ld.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id, ld.obligor_party_id, ld.institution_id
),
obligor_max_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        obligor_party_id,
        MAX(max_principal_balance) AS max_exposure
    FROM loan_balance
    GROUP BY institution_id, obligor_party_id
),
institution_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        institution_id,
        MAX(net_capital) AS net_capital
    FROM capital_snapshot
    GROUP BY institution_id
),
exposure_ratio AS (
    SELECT 
        ome.institution_id,
        ome.obligor_party_id,
        ome.max_exposure,
        ic.net_capital,
        (ome.max_exposure * 1.0 / ic.net_capital) AS exposure_ratio
    FROM obligor_max_exposure ome
    JOIN institution_capital ic ON ome.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    WHERE ic.net_capital > 0
),
ranked_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        er.institution_id,
        er.obligor_party_id,
        er.exposure_ratio,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY er.institution_id ORDER BY er.exposure_ratio DESC) AS rn
    FROM exposure_ratio er
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    re.exposure_ratio
FROM ranked_exposure re
JOIN institution i ON re.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN party p ON re.obligor_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE re.rn = 1
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC;

WITH ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        NTILE(4) OVER (PARTITION BY lbs.loan_id ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC) AS bucket_id
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    bucket_id
FROM ranked_loans
ORDER BY bucket_id ASC, principal_balance DESC
LIMIT 300;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.institution_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY ld.institution_id
),
latest_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.loan_id,
        ca.institution_id,
        lbs.principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    lb.loan_id,
    i.institution_name,
    lb.principal_balance,
    ROUND(lb.principal_balance * 100.0 / lt.total_principal, 2) AS ratio_pct
FROM latest_balances lb
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lb.institution_id
JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.institution_id = lb.institution_id
ORDER BY i.institution_name ASC, ratio_pct DESC, lb.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ROUND(SUM(ld.disbursed_amount), 2) AS total_disbursed,
    ld.status,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS overdue_principal_total,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'NORMAL'
  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY ld.loan_id, ld.status
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC, overdue_principal_total DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on, COUNT(*) AS loan_cnt
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY loan_cnt DESC, ld.loan_account_id, ld.disbursed_on
LIMIT 200;

SELECT DISTINCT p.party_id
FROM party p
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ah.account_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN account_holder ah2 ON ah2.party_id = p.party_id
JOIN account a2 ON a2.account_id = ah2.account_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
ORDER BY p.party_id;

SELECT sm.person_party_id
FROM staff_member sm
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = (
    SELECT ou.institution_id
    FROM organization_unit ou
    WHERE ou.org_unit_id = sm.home_org_unit_id
)
WHERE sm.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM account_holder ah
    WHERE ah.party_id = sm.person_party_id
  )
ORDER BY sm.person_party_id;

SELECT a.account_id
FROM account a
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
  AND a.is_external = 0
  AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM payment_event pe
      WHERE pe.from_account_id = a.account_id
        AND pe.is_cash = 1
  )
ORDER BY a.account_id
LIMIT 300;

SELECT
    sa.security_id,
    gc.guaranteed_amount
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
WHERE sa.status = 'EXPIRED'
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, sa.security_id;

SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN julianday(ld.original_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') < 0 THEN '已到期'
        WHEN julianday(ld.original_maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') <= 90 THEN '临期'
        ELSE '常态'
    END AS maturity_bucket,
    COUNT(*) AS loan_count
FROM loan_drawdown ld
GROUP BY maturity_bucket
ORDER BY
    CASE maturity_bucket
        WHEN '常态' THEN 1
        WHEN '临期' THEN 2
        WHEN '已到期' THEN 3
    END;

SELECT
    cl.collateral_id,
    COUNT(*) AS link_count
FROM
    collateral_link cl
JOIN
    security_agreement sa ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id
WHERE
    sa.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY
    cl.collateral_id
HAVING
    COUNT(*) > 1
ORDER BY
    link_count DESC,
    cl.collateral_id;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_type,
    ROUND(AVG(cv.valuation_amount), 2) AS avg_valuation_amount,
    COUNT(*) AS valuation_count
FROM collateral_valuation cv
JOIN collateral_asset ca ON ca.collateral_id = cv.collateral_id
WHERE cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL'
GROUP BY ca.collateral_type
ORDER BY avg_valuation_amount DESC;

WITH account_loan_count AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    WHERE ld.repayment_account_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ld.repayment_account_id
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) >= 3
),
ranked_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.repayment_account_id,
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.disbursed_on,
        ld.disbursed_amount,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ld.repayment_account_id ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC) AS rn
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN account_loan_count alc ON ld.repayment_account_id = alc.repayment_account_id
)
SELECT 
    rl.repayment_account_id,
    rl.loan_id,
    rl.disbursed_on,
    ROUND(rl.disbursed_amount, 2) AS disbursed_amount,
    alc.loan_count
FROM ranked_loans rl
JOIN account_loan_count alc ON rl.repayment_account_id = alc.repayment_account_id
WHERE rl.rn <= 2
ORDER BY rl.repayment_account_id ASC, rl.disbursed_on ASC, rl.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.contract_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed_amount,
    SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) - ca.contract_amount AS excess_amount,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS drawdown_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, ca.contract_amount
HAVING SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) > ca.contract_amount
ORDER BY ca.agreement_id ASC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS account_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ABS(bs.ledger_balance - bs.available_balance)), 2) AS balance_difference_sum
FROM account a
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN account_balance_snapshot bs ON a.account_id = bs.account_id
WHERE bs.ledger_balance > bs.available_balance
  AND (bs.ledger_balance - bs.available_balance) > 5000000
GROUP BY i.institution_name
ORDER BY balance_difference_sum DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    td.account_id,
    td.opening_principal,
    td.maturity_on,
    td.annual_interest_rate
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = td.account_id
WHERE td.maturity_on < '2026-06-30'
  AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY td.maturity_on, td.account_id;

SELECT
    pc.card_id,
    pc.card_type,
    pc.issued_on
FROM payment_card pc
WHERE pc.issued_on <= '2025-01-31'
  AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
ORDER BY pc.issued_on, pc.card_id;

WITH payment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        a.institution_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'ENTRUSTED_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS entrusted_amount,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ld.payment_mode = 'SELF_PAYMENT' THEN ld.disbursed_amount ELSE 0 END) AS self_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement a ON ld.agreement_id = a.agreement_id
    GROUP BY a.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(ps.entrusted_amount, 2) AS entrusted_amount,
    ROUND(ps.self_amount, 2) AS self_amount,
    ROUND(ps.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / (ps.entrusted_amount + ps.self_amount), 4) AS entrusted_ratio
FROM payment_stats ps
JOIN institution i ON ps.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE (ps.entrusted_amount + ps.self_amount) > 0 
  AND ps.entrusted_amount * 1.0 / (ps.entrusted_amount + ps.self_amount) < 0.52
ORDER BY entrusted_ratio ASC, i.institution_name ASC;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        agreement_id,
        SUM(disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown
    GROUP BY agreement_id
)
SELECT 
    ld.agreement_id,
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_amount,
    lt.total_disbursed,
    ROUND(ld.disbursed_amount * 100.0 / lt.total_disbursed, 2) AS ratio_pct
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_totals lt ON lt.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_amount * 1.0 / lt.total_disbursed > 0.9
ORDER BY ld.agreement_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name AS 机构名称,
    SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) AS 实际募集合计,
    SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount) AS 计划募集合计,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 4) AS 完成率
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = wp.issuer_institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN wp.status = '在售' THEN wp.actual_raise_amount ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 4) > 1.2
ORDER BY 完成率 DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH borrower_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS total_loan_count,
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) AS overdue_loan_count
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
    HAVING 
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
        AND COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) > COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN rs.status = 'OVERDUE' THEN ld.loan_id END)
)
SELECT 
    bs.borrower_party_id,
    p.display_name,
    bs.overdue_loan_count,
    bs.total_loan_count
FROM borrower_stats bs
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = bs.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY bs.overdue_loan_count DESC, bs.borrower_party_id ASC;

SELECT
    pi.instruction_id,
    pi.loan_id,
    borrower.display_name AS borrower_name,
    payee.display_name AS payee_name,
    pi.instruction_amount
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = pi.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party borrower ON borrower.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
LEFT JOIN party payee ON payee.party_id = pi.intended_payee_party_id
WHERE pi.status = 'EXECUTED'
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id IS NOT NULL
  AND pi.intended_payee_party_id != ca.borrower_party_id
ORDER BY pi.instruction_amount DESC, pi.instruction_id

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.signed_on,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < ca.signed_on
ORDER BY ld.loan_id ASC;

WITH loan_installments AS (
    SELECT 
        rs.loan_id,
        COUNT(rs.installment_id) AS total_installments,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status = 'PAID' OR rs.status = 'CLOSED' THEN 1 END) AS paid_installments
    FROM repayment_schedule rs
    GROUP BY rs.loan_id
),
qualified_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        li.loan_id,
        li.total_installments,
        li.total_installments - li.paid_installments AS unpaid_installments,
        SUM(rs.principal_due) AS total_principal_due
    FROM loan_installments li
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = li.loan_id
    WHERE li.paid_installments = 0
    GROUP BY li.loan_id, li.total_installments
)
SELECT 
    ql.loan_id AS 借据编号,
    ql.unpaid_installments AS 未结清期次数,
    ROUND(ql.total_principal_due, 2) AS 应还本金合计
FROM qualified_loans ql
ORDER BY ql.total_principal_due DESC, ql.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT ld.loan_id,
       ROUND(lbs.principal_balance, 2) AS principal_balance,
       ROUND(lbs.overdue_principal, 2) AS overdue_principal
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE ld.status = 'WRITE_OFF'
  AND lbs.principal_balance > 10000000
ORDER BY lbs.principal_balance DESC, ld.loan_id ASC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursed_on,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.opened_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE ld.disbursed_on < a.opened_on
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_on ASC, ld.loan_id ASC;

SELECT
    ld.loan_id,
    ld.disbursement_account_id,
    a.account_kind,
    ld.disbursed_amount
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account a ON a.account_id = ld.disbursement_account_id
WHERE a.account_kind = 'SAVINGS'
ORDER BY ld.disbursed_amount DESC, ld.loan_id;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    ca.security_type,
    ca.contract_amount,
    p.display_name
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
WHERE ca.security_type = 'CREDIT'
  AND ca.contract_amount > 8000000
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC, ca.agreement_id;

WITH institution_avg_rate AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family,
        AVG(ca.annual_interest_rate) AS avg_rate
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id, ca.product_family
),
related_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        CASE 
            WHEN pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id THEN pr.target_party_id
            ELSE pr.source_party_id
        END AS related_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id OR pr.target_party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
    WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
),
filtered_agreements AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.agreement_id,
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        ca.annual_interest_rate,
        ca.institution_id,
        ca.product_family
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.annual_interest_rate IS NOT NULL
      AND ca.borrower_party_id IN (SELECT related_party_id FROM related_borrowers)
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    p.party_id AS borrower_id,
    fa.annual_interest_rate,
    ROUND(ia.avg_rate, 6) AS avg_rate,
    ROUND(fa.annual_interest_rate - ia.avg_rate, 6) AS rate_gap
FROM filtered_agreements fa
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = fa.borrower_party_id
JOIN institution_avg_rate ia ON ia.institution_id = fa.institution_id AND ia.product_family = fa.product_family
WHERE fa.annual_interest_rate < ia.avg_rate
ORDER BY rate_gap DESC, fa.agreement_id;

SELECT
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    rtc.relation_name_zh
FROM party_relation pr
JOIN relation_type_catalog rtc ON rtc.relation_type = pr.relation_type
JOIN party p1 ON p1.party_id = pr.source_party_id
JOIN party p2 ON p2.party_id = pr.target_party_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld1 ON ld1.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p1.party_id
)
JOIN loan_drawdown ld2 ON ld2.agreement_id IN (
    SELECT ca.agreement_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = p2.party_id
)
WHERE rtc.relation_name_zh != '非关联方'
ORDER BY rtc.relation_name_zh, pr.relation_id;

SELECT
    eg.group_name AS 集团名称,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS 成员数,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 余额合计,
    cs.net_capital AS 资本净额,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital, 4) AS 占比
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_exposure re ON re.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id = re.agreement_id
JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = eg.institution_id
WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
    WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
)
AND cs.as_of_date = (
    SELECT MAX(cs2.as_of_date)
    FROM capital_snapshot cs2
    WHERE cs2.institution_id = eg.institution_id
)
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name, cs.net_capital
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 2
   AND SUM(lbs.principal_balance) * 1.0 / cs.net_capital > 0.1
ORDER BY 占比 DESC
LIMIT 200;

SELECT
    payer_party.display_name AS 付款方姓名,
    payee_party.display_name AS 收款方姓名,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pe.payment_id) AS 转账笔数,
    ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 转账金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account from_acc ON pe.from_account_id = from_acc.account_id
JOIN account to_acc ON pe.to_account_id = to_acc.account_id
JOIN account_holder payer_holder ON from_acc.account_id = payer_holder.account_id
JOIN account_holder payee_holder ON to_acc.account_id = payee_holder.account_id
JOIN party payer_party ON payer_holder.party_id = payer_party.party_id
JOIN party payee_party ON payee_holder.party_id = payee_party.party_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON (pr.source_party_id = payer_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payee_party.party_id)
                       OR (pr.source_party_id = payee_party.party_id AND pr.target_party_id = payer_party.party_id)
WHERE pr.relation_type != '非关联方'
GROUP BY payer_party.display_name, payee_party.display_name
ORDER BY 转账金额合计 DESC, payer_party.display_name, payee_party.display_name;

SELECT DISTINCT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ma.asset_name
FROM wealth_product wp
JOIN product_holding_snapshot phs ON phs.product_id = wp.product_id
JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
WHERE wp.risk_level = 'R5'
  AND wp.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND phs.lookthrough_depth > 1
ORDER BY wp.product_id;

SELECT
    wps.product_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT wps.asset_id) AS asset_count
FROM product_holding_snapshot wps
WHERE wps.lookthrough_depth > 1
GROUP BY wps.product_id
ORDER BY asset_count DESC, wps.product_id
LIMIT 20;

WITH overdue_loans AS (
    SELECT 
        lbs.loan_id,
        lbs.principal_balance,
        MAX(ds.principal_overdue_days) AS max_overdue_days
    FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = lbs.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.principal_balance > 90000000
      AND lbs.overdue_principal IS NOT NULL
      AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
    GROUP BY lbs.loan_id, lbs.principal_balance
)
SELECT 
    loan_id,
    principal_balance,
    max_overdue_days
FROM overdue_loans
WHERE max_overdue_days >= 200
ORDER BY max_overdue_days DESC, loan_id;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT re.institution_id) AS institution_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS member_count
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_exposure re ON re.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
    AND re.obligor_party_id = egm.party_id
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT re.institution_id) >= 2
ORDER BY institution_count DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

SELECT
    eg.exposure_group_id,
    eg.group_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS overdue_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(d.overdue_principal), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM exposure_group_member egm
JOIN exposure_group eg ON eg.exposure_group_id = egm.exposure_group_id
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id IN (
    SELECT ld.loan_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date)
        FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2
        WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    )
    AND lbs.overdue_principal > 0
)
JOIN delinquency_snapshot d ON d.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    AND d.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(d2.as_of_date)
        FROM delinquency_snapshot d2
        WHERE d2.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    )
WHERE d.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY eg.exposure_group_id, eg.group_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, eg.exposure_group_id;

WITH guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(ca.contract_amount) AS total_borrowed_amount
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY ca.borrower_party_id
),
qualified_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        gt.guarantor_party_id AS party_id
    FROM guarantor_totals gt
    JOIN borrower_totals bt ON bt.borrower_party_id = gt.guarantor_party_id
    WHERE gt.total_guaranteed_amount > bt.total_borrowed_amount
)
SELECT 
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    p.party_id AS customer_id,
    gt.total_guaranteed_amount AS total_guaranteed,
    bt.total_borrowed_amount AS total_borrowed,
    ROUND(gt.total_guaranteed_amount - bt.total_borrowed_amount, 2) AS guarantee_liability_gap
FROM qualified_customers qc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = qc.party_id
JOIN guarantor_totals gt ON gt.guarantor_party_id = qc.party_id
JOIN borrower_totals bt ON bt.borrower_party_id = qc.party_id
ORDER BY guarantee_liability_gap DESC, p.party_id;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS staff_name,

JOIN party p ON p.party_id = sm.person_party_id

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = sm.person_party_id

SELECT

    p.party_id AS 客户编号,
    ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS 本金余额合计,

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id

SELECT
    p.display_name AS staff_name,
    ld.loan_id,

    ld.disbursed_on
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN account acc ON ld.disbursement_account_id = acc.account_id

        SUM(rs.principal_due + rs.interest_due) AS total_repayment_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
),

    expired_count,

HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.account_id) > 0
ORDER BY
    joint_account_count DESC,

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,

FROM loan_balance_snapshot ls
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.loan_id = ls.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ca.managing_org_unit_id
WHERE ls.overdue_principal > 0
GROUP BY ou.org_unit_id, ou.unit_name
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, ou.org_unit_id;

SELECT
    rs.loan_id,
    COUNT(*) AS overdue_installment_count,
    ROUND(SUM(rs.principal_due), 2) AS total_overdue_principal
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.paid_on IS NULL
  AND rs.status = 'OVERDUE'
GROUP BY rs.loan_id
HAVING total_overdue_principal > 120000000
ORDER BY total_overdue_principal DESC, rs.loan_id;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN 1 END) AS overdue_installment_count,
       SUM(CASE WHEN rs.status != 'PAID' THEN rs.interest_due ELSE 0 END) AS total_overdue_interest

JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id

JOIN repayment_schedule rs ON rs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING overdue_installment_count >= 30
ORDER BY overdue_installment_count DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT ls.loan_id) AS overdue_loan_count
FROM institution i
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ls ON ls.assessed_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
WHERE ls.overdue_principal > 0
   OR ls.overdue_interest > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ls.loan_id) >= 240
ORDER BY overdue_loan_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT rs.loan_id, rs.installment_no, rs.principal_due, rs.interest_due
FROM repayment_schedule rs
WHERE rs.status = 'OVERDUE' AND rs.principal_due > 90000000
ORDER BY rs.principal_due DESC, rs.loan_id, rs.installment_no;

WITH credit_limits AS (
    SELECT
        cf.institution_id,
        SUM(cf.limit_amount) AS total_credit_limit
    FROM credit_facility cf
    GROUP BY cf.institution_id
),
loan_disbursements AS (
    SELECT
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(ld.disbursed_amount) AS total_disbursed
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
institution_disbursements AS (

    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
capital_net AS (

)
SELECT

JOIN institution_disbursements id ON id.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN capital_net cn ON cn.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE id.total_loan_disbursed > cn.net_capital
ORDER BY 发放对资本净额占比 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT

SELECT pmc.payment_mode_name_zh, COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS loan_count

SELECT

SELECT

    instrument_type_catalog itc
CROSS JOIN
    status_catalog sc
WHERE
    sc.entity = 'loan_drawdown'
ORDER BY

SELECT
    ou.org_unit_id,
    ou.unit_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM organization_unit ou
JOIN staff_assignment sa ON sa.org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = sa.staff_id
JOIN industry_sector isec ON isec.sector_code = sa.role_code

    ds.principal_overdue_days,

JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code

    stage2_with_provision as (
        select 
            ps.loan_id,
            ps.required_amount as required_provision,
            ps.recognized_amount as recognized_provision,
            ps.as_of_date
        from provision_snapshot ps
        join stage2_loans s2 on s2.loan_id = ps.loan_id
        where ps.provision_stage = 'STAGE2' -- 假设二阶段标记为 'STAGE2'
          and ps.as_of_date = (
              select max(ps2.as_of_date) 
              from provision_snapshot ps2 
              where ps2.loan_id = ps.loan_id
          )
    ),
    weak_provision_loans as (
        select 
            s2p.loan_id,
            ld.agreement_id
        from stage2_with_provision s2p
        join loan_drawdown ld on ld.loan_id = s2p.loan_id
        where s2p.required_amount > 0
          and s2p.recognized_amount * 1.0 / s2p.required_amount < 0.5
    ),
    institution_counts as (
        select 
            ca.institution_id,
            count(wpl.loan_id) as weak_count
        from credit_agreement ca
        join weak_provision_loans wpl on wpl.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
        group by ca.institution_id
    )
    select 
        i.institution_name,
        ic.weak_count
    from institution_counts ic
    join institution i on i.institution_id = ic.institution_id
    order by ic.weak_count desc, i.institution_name asc;

SELECT

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
       ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,
       COUNT(pe.payment_id) AS 交易笔数,
       ROUND(SUM(pe.amount), 2) AS 金额合计
FROM payment_event pe
JOIN account acc_from ON acc_from.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN account_holder ah ON ah.account_id = acc_from.account_id
JOIN organization_unit ou ON ou.org_unit_id = ah.holder_party_id -- 注意：这里假设 holder_party_id 关联的是 party，而 party 的 home_org_unit_id 关联 org_unit。但题目要求“持卡人所属营业单元”，通常指 party 的 home_org_unit_id。
-- 修正：account_holder 关联 party_id，party 表有 home_org_unit_id。
-- 重新梳理关联：payment_event -> from_account -> account_holder -> party -> organization_unit (via home_org_unit_id)
-- 但是 account_holder 表只有 account_id, party_id, holder_role。
-- party 表有 party_id, home_org_unit_id。
-- organization_unit 表有 org_unit_id, unit_name。

-- 让我们重新构建正确的 JOIN 路径：
-- 1. payment_event (pe) 有 from_account_id
-- 2. account (acc) 有 account_id, 且 is_external=0 (结算账户通常非外部，但题目未明确，仅说“贷记卡结算账户”，通常指本行账户。不过题目只说了“贷记卡结算账户作为付款转出账户”，并未限制 is_external。但通常结算账户是本行的。这里先不限制 is_external，除非有明确证据。题目中 account 表有 is_external 字段。贷记卡结算账户通常是本行的，即 is_external=0。但为了严谨，看题目描述“贷记卡结算账户”，在 banking 语境下，结算账户是存款账户，贷记卡是信用卡。这里可能指信用卡的还款账户或关联的结算账户。题目说“贷记卡结算账户”，可能是指用于结算贷记卡交易的账户，或者就是普通的结算账户。鉴于题目没有给出 card 和 account 的直接关联用于付款，而是通过 payment_event 的 from_account_id。
-- 题目限定：“贷记卡结算账户”。在 schema 中，account 表有 account_kind。通常结算账户 kind 可能是 'SETTLEMENT' 或类似。但题目没有给出 account_kind 的具体枚举值。
-- 再看 payment_card 表，有 settlement_account_id。
-- 题目说“贷记卡结算账户作为付款转出账户”。这可能意味着 from_account_id 是 payment_card 表中的 settlement_account_id。
-- 所以路径应该是：payment_event -> from_account -> payment_card (settlement_account_id) -> holder_party_id -> party -> home_org_unit_id -> organization_unit。
-- 并且需要过滤 is_cash = 1 (现金交易)。

-- 修正后的路径：
-- payment_event (pe)
-- JOIN account (acc) ON pe.from_account_id = acc.account_id
-- JOIN payment_card (pc) ON acc.account_id = pc.settlement_account_id

-- JOIN organization_unit (ou) ON p.home_org_unit_id = ou.org_unit_id

-- 过滤条件：

-- 题目隐含：贷记卡结算账户，即通过 payment_card 关联的账户。

SELECT ou.org_unit_id AS 营业单元编号,
       ou.unit_name AS 营业单元名称,

JOIN account acc ON acc.account_id = pe.from_account_id
JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = acc.account_id

),
valid_guarantees AS (

guarantee_coverage as (

    from secured_obligation so
    join security_agreement sa on so.security_id = sa.security_id
    where sa.status = 'ACTIVE'

    group by so.agreement_id
)

order by 保障缺口 desc, ca.agreement_id

join risk_classification rc on rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id and rc.as_of_date = ps.as_of_date

with loan_balance as (

),
loan_info as (
    select 
        ld.loan_id,
        ld.agreement_id,

    from loan_drawdown ld
    join credit_agreement ca on ld.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
),
combined as (
    select 
        li.borrower_party_id,
        lb.loan_id,
        lb.loan_balance,

    from loan_balance lb
    join loan_info li on lb.loan_id = li.loan_id
    where li.contract_amount > 0
)
select

    loan_id,
    loan_balance,
    contract_amount,

with provision_excess as (

        ps.loan_id,
        ps.required_amount,

    from provision_snapshot ps
    where ps.recognized_amount > ps.required_amount
),
loan_grade as (
    select 
        rc.loan_id,
        cg.grade_name_zh as grade_name
    from risk_classification rc
    join classification_grade cg on rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
    where rc.as_of_date = (
        select max(rc2.as_of_date) 
        from risk_classification rc2 
        where rc2.loan_id = rc.loan_id
    )
),
loan_info as (

    from loan_drawdown ld
),
agreement_info as (

    from credit_agreement ca

from provision_excess pe
join loan_grade lg on pe.loan_id = lg.loan_id
join loan_info li on pe.loan_id = li.loan_id
join agreement_info ai on li.agreement_id = ai.agreement_id
join institution i on ai.institution_id = i.institution_id
group by i.institution_name, lg.grade_name
order by 多计提金额合计 desc, i.institution_name, lg.grade_name

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) AS internal_max_valuation,
    MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) AS external_max_valuation,
    ROUND(
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) -
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END),
        2
    ) AS valuation_difference
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
GROUP BY ca.collateral_id, ca.asset_label
HAVING
    MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) IS NOT NULL
    AND MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'INTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END) >
        MAX(CASE WHEN cv.appraiser_kind = 'EXTERNAL' THEN cv.valuation_amount END)
ORDER BY valuation_difference DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT
    ca.collateral_id,
    ca.asset_label,
    cv.valuation_amount,
    cl.total_pledged_amount,
    ROUND(cl.total_pledged_amount - cv.valuation_amount, 2) AS coverage_gap
FROM collateral_asset ca
JOIN collateral_valuation cv ON cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        cl2.collateral_id,
        SUM(cl2.pledged_amount) AS total_pledged_amount
    FROM collateral_link cl2
    WHERE cl2.status = 'ACTIVE'
    GROUP BY cl2.collateral_id
) cl ON cl.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
JOIN (
    SELECT
        collateral_id,
        MAX(valued_on) AS max_valued_on
    FROM collateral_valuation
    GROUP BY collateral_id
) latest_cv ON latest_cv.collateral_id = ca.collateral_id
WHERE cv.valued_on = latest_cv.max_valued_on
ORDER BY coverage_gap DESC, ca.collateral_id;

SELECT

    SELECT s2.security_id

SELECT

    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ld.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id THEN ld.loan_id END) AS source_loan_count,

FROM party_relation pr
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON ld.agreement_id IS NOT NULL
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
WHERE pr.relation_type != 'NON_RELATED'
  AND (
      (ld.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id AND ca.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id)
      OR
      (ld.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id AND ca.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id)
  )
GROUP BY
    pr.relation_id,
    pr.source_party_id,
    pr.target_party_id
HAVING
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ld.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
    AND COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ld.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id THEN ld.loan_id END) > 0
ORDER BY
    (COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ld.borrower_party_id = pr.source_party_id THEN ld.loan_id END) + COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ld.borrower_party_id = pr.target_party_id THEN ld.loan_id END)) DESC,
    pr.relation_id;
