WITH guarantor_totals AS (
    SELECT 
        gc.guarantor_party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(gc.guaranteed_amount), 2) AS total_guaranteed_amount
    FROM guarantor_commitment gc
    WHERE gc.status = 'ACTIVE'
      AND gc.effective_to IS NULL
    GROUP BY gc.guarantor_party_id
),
borrower_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        ROUND(SUM(lbs.principal_balance), 2) AS total_loan_exposure
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ca.borrower_party_id = ld.borrower_party_id
      AND lbs.as_of_date = (
          SELECT MAX(lbs2.as_of_date) 
          FROM loan_balance_snapshot lbs2 
          WHERE lbs2.loan_id = ld.loan_id
      )
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    p.party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    gt.total_guaranteed_amount AS 有效保证责任合计,
    COALESCE(be.total_loan_exposure, 0) AS 自身贷款金额,
    ROUND(gt.total_guaranteed_amount - COALESCE(be.total_loan_exposure, 0), 2) AS 超额担保金额
FROM party p
JOIN guarantor_totals gt ON gt.guarantor_party_id = p.party_id
LEFT JOIN borrower_exposure be ON be.borrower_party_id = p.party_id
WHERE gt.total_guaranteed_amount > COALESCE(be.total_loan_exposure, 0)
ORDER BY 超额担保金额 DESC, p.party_id;

WITH overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ld.obligor_party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
)
SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    gc.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    gc.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = gc.security_id
JOIN overdue_borrowers ob ON ob.obligor_party_id = sa.institution_id -- 注意：这里需要关联到具体的借款人，但security_agreement只关联了institution。
-- 重新审视逻辑：
-- 1. 找出有逾期借据的借款人 (obligor_party_id)。
-- 2. 找出这些借款人作为被担保方（即他们的债务被担保）的保证人。
-- 但是，guarantor_commitment 表中的 guarantor_party_id 是保证人，security_id 关联到 security_agreement。
-- security_agreement 表中有 institution_id，但没有直接关联到具体的 loan_id 或 obligor_party_id。
-- 然而，secured_obligation 表关联了 security_id 和 agreement_id。
-- credit_agreement 表中有 borrower_party_id。
-- 所以路径是：
-- 1. 找到有逾期的 loan_drawdown -> 找到对应的 credit_agreement (通过 loan_drawdown.agreement_id) -> 找到 borrower_party_id。
-- 2. 找到这些 borrower_party_id 对应的 credit_agreement 关联的 security_agreement (通过 secured_obligation)。
-- 3. 找到这些 security_agreement 关联的 guarantor_commitment。

WITH overdue_loans AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ld.loan_id, ld.agreement_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days > 0
),
overdue_agreements AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT agreement_id
    FROM overdue_loans
),
overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.borrower_party_id
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    WHERE ca.agreement_id IN (SELECT agreement_id FROM overdue_agreements)
),
affected_security_ids AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT so.security_id
    FROM secured_obligation so
    JOIN overdue_agreements oa ON so.agreement_id = oa.agreement_id
)
SELECT 
    gc.guarantor_party_id AS 保证人编号,
    p.display_name AS 保证人名称,
    gc.guaranteed_amount AS 保证金额,
    gc.status AS 保证状态
FROM guarantor_commitment gc
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = gc.guarantor_party_id
JOIN affected_security_ids asi ON gc.security_id = asi.security_id
ORDER BY gc.guaranteed_amount DESC, gc.guarantor_party_id ASC;

WITH RECURSIVE investment_path AS (
    -- 基础层：直接持有底层资产的理财产品
    SELECT 
        phs.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.investment_path,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        ma.issuer_party_id AS issuer_party_id,
        ma.obligor_party_id AS obligor_party_id,
        ma.asset_name
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
    WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 递归层：如果底层资产本身是另一个理财产品，则继续穿透
    SELECT 
        ip.product_id,
        ma2.asset_id,
        ip.investment_path || ' -> ' || ma2.asset_name,
        ip.lookthrough_depth + 1,
        ma2.issuer_party_id,
        ma2.obligor_party_id,
        ma2.asset_name
    FROM investment_path ip
    JOIN managed_asset ma2 ON ma2.asset_id = ip.asset_id
    WHERE ma2.asset_category_primary = 'WEALTH_PRODUCT' -- 假设底层资产如果是理财产品，其类别会有标识，或者通过关联 wealth_product 表判断
    -- 注意：Schema 中 managed_asset 没有直接标识是否为理财产品的字段，但 product_holding_snapshot 关联了 wealth_product。
    -- 如果 asset_id 在 wealth_product 表中存在，则说明是嵌套理财。
    -- 这里我们需要检查 asset_id 是否对应一个 wealth_product。
    -- 由于 managed_asset 和 wealth_product 是独立的表，我们需要通过 asset_id 是否存在于某个理财产品的持有关系中，或者更直接地，
    -- 如果 asset_id 是 managed_asset，且该 asset 是由另一个 wealth_product 发行的（即 issuer_party_id 是机构，但 asset 本身可能是另一个理财的标的？不，通常理财持有的是资产）。
    -- 让我们重新审视逻辑：
    -- 1. 理财产品 (wealth_product) 持有 底层资产 (managed_asset)。
    -- 2. 如果底层资产 (managed_asset) 本身也是一个理财产品 (wealth_product) 的标的？不，managed_asset 是资产。
    -- 3. 题目说“多层嵌套”，通常指 理财A 持有 理财B，理财B 持有 资产C。
    -- 4. 在 Schema 中，product_holding_snapshot 关联 product_id (wealth_product) 和 asset_id (managed_asset)。
    -- 5. 如果 asset_id (managed_asset) 对应的资产，其发行方或结构表明它也是一个理财产品？
    -- 6. 查看 managed_asset 表，有 asset_category_primary。如果它是 'WEALTH_PRODUCT' 或类似，则可能嵌套。
    -- 7. 但更常见的嵌套是：理财A 持有 资管计划B，资管计划B 持有 资产C。
    -- 8. 在本题 Schema 中，似乎没有明确的“资管计划”表，只有 wealth_product 和 managed_asset。
    -- 9. 假设 managed_asset 可以是另一个 wealth_product 的“资产”吗？通常不会。
    -- 10. 另一种嵌套：理财A 持有 资产B，资产B 是 理财C 的份额？
    -- 11. 让我们看 product_holding_snapshot 的 lookthrough_depth。如果 lookthrough_depth > 1，说明已经穿透了。
    -- 12. 题目要求“最终持有的底层资产”。
    -- 13. 如果 lookthrough_depth 已经是最大深度，或者该资产不再被其他理财持有？
    -- 14. 实际上，SQLite 不支持递归 CTE 中的自引用检查“是否被其他表引用”来终止递归，除非我们构建完整的图。
    -- 15. 简化思路：题目可能暗示 lookthrough_depth 最大的那些记录即为最终底层资产。
    -- 16. 或者，如果 asset_id 对应的 managed_asset 的 issuer_party_id 是本行，且该资产本身是一个理财产品？
    -- 17. 让我们假设：如果 managed_asset 的 asset_category_primary 是 'WEALTH_PRODUCT' (或类似)，则它可能是一个嵌套的理财。
    -- 18. 但更稳妥的方式是：找出所有 lookthrough_depth 最大的记录。
    
    -- 修正递归逻辑：
    -- 基础：所有直接持有关系 (depth 1)
    -- 递归：如果当前持有的 asset_id 对应的 managed_asset，其本身又被其他 wealth_product 持有（即它是另一个理财的底层资产），则继续向上追溯？
    -- 不，题目是“理财产品...持有的...最终债务人”。方向是 理财 -> 资产 -> 债务人。
    -- 嵌套是指 理财A -> 理财B -> 资产C。
    -- 在 product_holding_snapshot 中，如果 asset_id 对应的是一个 wealth_product 的标的？
    -- 实际上，managed_asset 表中的 asset_category_primary 可能包含 'WEALTH_PRODUCT' 吗？通常不会，理财是产品，资产是标的。
    -- 但有一种情况：理财A 持有 理财B 的份额。此时 product_holding_snapshot 中 product_id=A, asset_id=B? 
    -- 不，asset_id 是 managed_asset。如果 managed_asset 代表的是“理财份额”，那么 asset_category_primary 可能是 'FUND_SHARE' 或 'WEALTH_PRODUCT'

SELECT
    sa.security_type,
    COUNT(sa.security_id) AS contract_count,
    ROUND(SUM(sa.secured_amount), 2) AS total_secured_amount
FROM security_agreement sa
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.security_id = sa.security_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = so.agreement_id
WHERE ca.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY sa.security_type
ORDER BY SUM(sa.secured_amount) DESC, sa.security_type;

SELECT
    ca.agreement_id,
    p.display_name AS borrower_name,
    ROUND(ca.contract_amount, 2) AS contract_amount,
    COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) AS collateral_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) AS guarantor_count
FROM credit_agreement ca
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = ca.borrower_party_id
JOIN secured_obligation so ON so.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
JOIN security_agreement sa ON sa.security_id = so.security_id
LEFT JOIN collateral_link cl ON cl.security_id = sa.security_id AND cl.status = 'EFFECTIVE'
LEFT JOIN guarantor_commitment gc ON gc.security_id = sa.security_id AND gc.status = 'EFFECTIVE'
WHERE ca.status = 'EFFECTIVE'
GROUP BY ca.agreement_id, p.display_name, ca.contract_amount
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT cl.collateral_id) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT gc.commitment_id) > 0
ORDER BY ca.contract_amount DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) AS distinct_member_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ca.contract_amount), 2) AS total_contract_amount
FROM exposure_group eg
JOIN exposure_group_member egm ON egm.exposure_group_id = eg.exposure_group_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.borrower_party_id = egm.party_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = eg.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT egm.party_id) >= 5
ORDER BY SUM(ca.contract_amount) DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    wp.product_id,
    wp.product_name,
    ROUND(SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value), 2) AS 倒挂金额合计,
    COUNT(phs.holding_id) AS 构成倒挂的持仓笔数
FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = phs.product_id
WHERE phs.carrying_amount > phs.fair_value
GROUP BY wp.product_id, wp.product_name
HAVING SUM(phs.carrying_amount - phs.fair_value) > 0
ORDER BY 倒挂金额合计 DESC, wp.product_id;

WITH RECURSIVE holding_chain AS (
    -- 基础层：直接持有底层资产的持仓
    SELECT 
        phs.holding_id,
        phs.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        phs.converted_amount AS holding_book_value,
        ma.issuer_party_id AS final_issuer_id,
        ma.asset_name
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
    WHERE phs.lookthrough_depth = 1
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- 递归层：向上穿透持有上层产品的持仓
    SELECT 
        phs.holding_id,
        phs.product_id,
        phs.asset_id,
        phs.lookthrough_depth,
        phs.converted_amount AS holding_book_value,
        ma.issuer_party_id AS final_issuer_id,
        ma.asset_name
    FROM product_holding_snapshot phs
    JOIN holding_chain hc ON phs.asset_id = hc.product_id
    JOIN managed_asset ma ON ma.asset_id = phs.asset_id
),
-- 筛选嵌套深度 >= 3 的持仓
deep_holdings AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM holding_chain
    WHERE lookthrough_depth >= 3
),
-- 找出本行存在逾期借据的借款人
overdue_borrowers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ld.borrower_party_id
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
      AND ca.institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM institution LIMIT 1) -- 假设“本行”为第一条记录，实际应传入具体ID
),
-- 计算每个发行人的逾期本金合计
issuer_overdue_amounts AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.borrower_party_id,
        SUM(lbs.overdue_principal) AS total_overdue_principal
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.overdue_principal > 0
      AND ld.agreement_id IN (
          SELECT agreement_id FROM credit_agreement WHERE institution_id = (SELECT institution_id FROM institution LIMIT 1)
      )
    GROUP BY ld.borrower_party_id
)
SELECT 
    wp.product_name AS 产品名称,
    dh.asset_name AS 底层资产名称,
    dh.lookthrough_depth AS 嵌套深度,
    dh.holding_book_value AS 持仓账面价值,
    COALESCE(ioa.total_overdue_principal, 0) AS 该发行人的逾期本金合计
FROM deep_holdings dh
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.product_id = dh.product_id
JOIN issuer_overdue_amounts ioa ON ioa.borrower_party_id = dh.final_issuer_id
WHERE dh.final_issuer_id IN (SELECT borrower_party_id FROM overdue_borrowers)
ORDER BY dh.lookthrough_depth DESC, dh.holding_id;

WITH valid_pledges AS (
    SELECT 
        cl.collateral_id,
        cl.lien_priority,
        cl.pledge_ratio
    FROM collateral_link cl
    WHERE cl.status = '有效' 
      AND cl.lien_priority = 1
),
stats AS (
    SELECT 
        vp.collateral_id,
        COUNT(*) AS first_priority_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN vp.pledge_ratio > 0.6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_ratio_count
    FROM valid_pledges vp
    GROUP BY vp.collateral_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
)
SELECT 
    s.collateral_id,
    s.first_priority_count,
    s.high_ratio_count
FROM stats s
ORDER BY s.high_ratio_count DESC, s.collateral_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    fs.total_assets,
    fs.total_liabilities,
    fs.net_assets,
    fs.annual_revenue
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
ORDER BY fs.annual_revenue DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    ROUND(SUM(fs.total_liabilities) * 1.0 / SUM(fs.total_assets), 4) AS asset_liability_ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id
ORDER BY asset_liability_ratio DESC, i.institution_id;

SELECT
    c.institution_id,
    ROUND(c.tier1_capital * 1.0 / c.risk_weighted_assets, 4) AS core_tier1_ratio
FROM capital_snapshot c
WHERE c.tier1_capital IS NOT NULL
  AND c.risk_weighted_assets IS NOT NULL
  AND c.risk_weighted_assets != 0
ORDER BY core_tier1_ratio DESC, c.institution_id;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(cs.net_capital * 1.0 / fs.total_assets, 6) AS ratio
FROM institution i
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
JOIN capital_snapshot cs ON cs.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE fs.total_assets > 0
ORDER BY ratio DESC, i.institution_id;

WITH inst_rev AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.annual_revenue
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    WHERE fs.annual_revenue IS NOT NULL
),
total_rev AS (
    SELECT SUM(annual_revenue) AS total_annual_revenue
    FROM inst_rev
)
SELECT 
    ir.institution_name,
    ir.annual_revenue,
    ROUND(ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.total_annual_revenue * 100.0, 2) AS revenue_ratio_pct
FROM inst_rev ir
CROSS JOIN total_rev tr
WHERE ir.annual_revenue * 1.0 / tr.total_annual_revenue > 0.15
ORDER BY revenue_ratio_pct DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS inconsistent_rating_count
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
WHERE ma.internal_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.external_rating IS NOT NULL
  AND ma.internal_rating != ma.external_rating
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY inconsistent_rating_count DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    mha.valuation_method,
    ROUND(SUM(mha.carrying_amount), 2) AS total_carrying_amount
FROM product_holding_snapshot mha
GROUP BY mha.valuation_method
ORDER BY total_carrying_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name AS institution_name,
       COUNT(*) AS account_count,
       ROUND(SUM(td.opening_principal), 2) AS total_principal
FROM institution i
JOIN account a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
JOIN term_deposit td ON td.account_id = a.account_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY total_principal DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(*) AS certificate_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE td.annual_interest_rate > 3.0
GROUP BY
    i.institution_id,
    i.institution_name
ORDER BY
    certificate_count DESC,
    i.institution_id;

SELECT
    so.authority_level,
    COUNT(DISTINCT so.operator_id) AS operator_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) AS staff_count
FROM service_operator so
JOIN staff_member sm ON sm.staff_id = so.staff_id
WHERE sm.employment_type = 'FIXED'
GROUP BY so.authority_level
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sm.staff_id) >= 10
ORDER BY operator_count DESC, so.authority_level;

SELECT i.institution_name, COUNT(*) AS deposit_count
FROM term_deposit td
JOIN account a ON td.account_id = a.account_id
JOIN institution i ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id
WHERE a.status = 'ACTIVE'
  AND td.maturity_on IS NOT NULL
  AND julianday(td.maturity_on) - julianday('2026-06-30') BETWEEN 0 AND 30
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
ORDER BY deposit_count DESC, i.institution_name;

WITH loan_provision_diff AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.institution_id,
        SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) AS under_provision_total
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
    JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE ps.recognized_amount < ps.required_amount
    GROUP BY ld.institution_id
    HAVING SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount) > 0
),
inst_net_assets AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.net_assets
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    inst_net_assets.institution_id,
    inst_net_assets.institution_name,
    ROUND(loan_provision_diff.under_provision_total, 2) AS under_provision_total,
    ROUND(inst_net_assets.net_assets, 2) AS net_assets,
    ROUND(loan_provision_diff.under_provision_total * 1.0 / inst_net_assets.net_assets * 100.0, 2) AS under_provision_pct
FROM loan_provision_diff
JOIN inst_net_assets ON inst_net_assets.institution_id = loan_provision_diff.institution_id
ORDER BY under_provision_pct DESC, inst_net_assets.institution_id;

SELECT cg.grade_name_zh,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM risk_classification rc
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN classification_grade cg ON rc.grade_code = cg.grade_code
WHERE rc.classification_basis = 'MANUAL'
  AND cg.is_nonperforming = 1
GROUP BY cg.grade_name_zh
HAVING COUNT(*) BETWEEN 60 AND 105
ORDER BY cnt DESC, cg.grade_name_zh;

SELECT
    i.institution_id,
    COUNT(ld.loan_id) AS 不良借据笔数,
    SUM(ds.overdue_principal) AS 逾期本金合计
FROM loan_drawdown ld
JOIN risk_classification rc ON rc.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN delinquency_snapshot ds ON ds.loan_id = ld.loan_id
JOIN credit_agreement ca ON ca.agreement_id = ld.agreement_id
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ca.institution_id
JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
WHERE ds.principal_overdue_days >= 90
  AND fs.annual_revenue > 0
GROUP BY i.institution_id
HAVING SUM(ds.overdue_principal) / fs.annual_revenue > 0.5
ORDER BY 逾期本金合计 DESC;

WITH loan_balances AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.agreement_id,
        SUM(lbs.principal_balance) AS total_principal_balance
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    WHERE lbs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM loan_balance_snapshot)
    GROUP BY ld.agreement_id
),
institution_exposure AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.institution_id,
        SUM(lb.total_principal_balance) AS total_loan_principal
    FROM credit_agreement ca
    JOIN loan_balances lb ON lb.agreement_id = ca.agreement_id
    GROUP BY ca.institution_id
),
latest_capital AS (
    SELECT 
        cs.institution_id,
        cs.risk_weighted_assets
    FROM capital_snapshot cs
    WHERE cs.as_of_date = (SELECT MAX(as_of_date) FROM capital_snapshot)
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ROUND(ie.total_loan_principal, 2) AS 本金余额合计,
    ROUND(lc.risk_weighted_assets, 2) AS 风险加权资产,
    ROUND(ie.total_loan_principal * 1.0 / lc.risk_weighted_assets * 100.0, 2) AS 贷款占风险加权资产百分比
FROM institution_exposure ie
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ie.institution_id
JOIN latest_capital lc ON lc.institution_id = ie.institution_id
WHERE lc.risk_weighted_assets > 0
ORDER BY 贷款占风险加权资产百分比 DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT pi.payment_mode,
       COUNT(*) AS cnt
FROM payment_instruction pi
JOIN loan_drawdown ld ON pi.loan_id = ld.loan_id
WHERE pi.status = 'PENDING'
  AND ld.status = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY pi.payment_mode
HAVING COUNT(*) > 45
ORDER BY cnt DESC, pi.payment_mode;

WITH inst_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS exception_cnt,
        SUM(r.amount_value) AS exception_amount
    FROM prudential_metric_snapshot_v3 r
    WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 8
),
inst_financials AS (
    SELECT 
        i.institution_id,
        i.institution_name,
        fs.net_capital,
        fs.total_assets
    FROM institution i
    JOIN financial_snapshot fs ON fs.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    -- Assuming we take the latest snapshot or a specific one if needed, 
    -- but schema doesn't specify a date filter for the "current" financials. 
    -- Usually, we might need to pick the latest as_of_date. 
    -- However, without a specific date context in the prompt, we join directly. 
    -- To be safe and deterministic, let's assume we want the latest available snapshot per institution.
    -- But the prompt implies a simple join. Let's look at the schema again.
    -- financial_snapshot has as_of_date. The prompt doesn't specify a date.
    -- Let's assume we join on the institution and pick the latest record or just join if 1:1.
    -- Given the complexity, let's assume a simple join for now, or use a subquery to get the latest.
    -- Let's use a subquery to get the latest financial snapshot for each institution to be precise.
    WHERE fs.as_of_date = (
        SELECT MAX(fs2.as_of_date) 
        FROM financial_snapshot fs2 
        WHERE fs2.party_id = 'PTY-' || i.institution_id
    )
)
SELECT 
    inst_financials.institution_name,
    inst_metrics.exception_cnt,
    inst_metrics.exception_amount,
    inst_financials.net_capital,
    inst_financials.total_assets,
    ROUND(inst_metrics.exception_amount * 1.0 / inst_financials.net_capital * 100.0, 4) AS pct_of_net_capital
FROM inst_metrics
JOIN inst_financials ON inst_financials.institution_id = inst_metrics.institution_id
ORDER BY pct_of_net_capital DESC;

WITH loan_provision_gap AS (
    SELECT 
        ld.institution_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ld.loan_id) AS insufficient_provision_count,
        ROUND(SUM(ps.required_amount - ps.recognized_amount), 2) AS provision_gap_amount
    FROM loan_drawdown ld
    JOIN loan_balance_snapshot lbs ON lbs.loan_id = ld.loan_id
    JOIN provision_snapshot ps ON ps.loan_id = ld.loan_id AND ps.as_of_date = lbs.as_of_date
    WHERE ps.required_amount > ps.recognized_amount
    GROUP BY ld.institution_id
),
regulatory_overdue AS (
    SELECT 
        r.institution_id,
        COUNT(*) AS overdue_record_count,
        ROUND(AVG(r.amount_value), 2) AS avg_amount
    FROM regulatory_submission_event_v3 r
    WHERE r.completion_date IS NULL OR r.completion_date > r.deadline_date
    GROUP BY r.institution_id
)
SELECT 
    i.institution_name,
    ro.overdue_record_count,
    ro.avg_amount,
    lpg.insufficient_provision_count,
    lpg.provision_gap_amount
FROM loan_provision_gap lpg
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = lpg.institution_id
JOIN regulatory_overdue ro ON ro.institution_id = lpg.institution_id
WHERE ro.overdue_record_count >= 25
ORDER BY lpg.provision_gap_amount DESC;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(cf.facility_id) AS total_credit_facilities,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN r.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS except_amount,
       ROUND(AVG(r.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN credit_facility cf ON cf.institution_id = i.institution_id
LEFT JOIN governance_control_record_v3 r ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5
ORDER BY except_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT
    p.display_name AS customer_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.target_party_id) AS target_party_cnt,
    COUNT(DISTINCT pr.relation_type) AS relation_type_cnt,
    SUM(CASE WHEN rt.relation_name_zh != '非关联方' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS non_related_cnt
FROM related_transaction_record_v3 r
JOIN party p ON p.party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN party_relation pr ON pr.source_party_id = r.subject_id
JOIN relation_type_catalog rt ON rt.relation_type = pr.relation_type
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY r.subject_id, p.display_name
ORDER BY target_party_cnt DESC, relation_type_cnt DESC, customer_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.card_id) AS valid_card_count,
       COUNT(DISTINCT pc.holder_party_id) AS cardholder_count,
       ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.exception_flag = 1 THEN r.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS risk_exception_amount,
       COUNT(*) AS risk_valid_record_count
FROM institution i
LEFT JOIN account a ON a.institution_id = i.institution_id AND a.account_kind = 'SETTLEMENT' AND a.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN payment_card pc ON pc.settlement_account_id = a.account_id AND pc.status = 'ACTIVE'
LEFT JOIN operational_risk_event_v3 r ON r.institution_id = i.institution_id AND r.status_code = 'ACTIVE'
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 43
ORDER BY risk_exception_amount DESC, i.institution_name;

SELECT i.institution_name,
       COUNT(DISTINCT wp.product_id) AS active_product_cnt,
       ROUND(SUM(wp.actual_raise_amount), 2) AS total_actual_raise,
       COUNT(*) AS conduct_records,
       ROUND(AVG(r.ratio_value), 4) AS avg_ratio
FROM product_conduct_event_v3 r
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = r.institution_id
JOIN wealth_product wp ON wp.issuer_institution_id = i.institution_id AND wp.status = 'ACTIVE'
WHERE r.exception_flag = 1
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2
ORDER BY total_actual_raise DESC;

SELECT
    i.institution_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ma.asset_id) AS asset_count,
    ROUND(SUM(ma.issued_amount), 2) AS total_issued_amount,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN r.status_code = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 END) AS active_custody_records,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN r.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND r.exception_flag = 1 THEN r.amount_value ELSE 0 END), 2) AS active_except_amount
FROM managed_asset ma
JOIN institution i ON i.institution_id = ma.originator_institution_id
LEFT JOIN custody_operation_event_v3 r ON r.subject_id = ma.asset_id
GROUP BY i.institution_id, i.institution_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN r.status_code = 'ACTIVE' AND r.exception_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 2
ORDER BY total_issued_amount DESC, i.institution_name;
